failures.question: Show the number of orders per month for the last 6 months and the difference from the previous month.
failures.generated_sql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'completed'
      AND order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of month', '-5 months')
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_date)
)
SELECT 
    month,
    order_count,
    order_count - LAG(order_count, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS difference_from_previous_month
FROM monthly_orders
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 500;

records.question: How many orders did each customer from Pune place this year?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT c.name AS customer_name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of year')
WHERE c.city = 'Pune'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.name;

records.question: Which customers placed orders in both September and October 2026?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT c.name AS customer_name, c.city, c.country
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-10-01'
INTERSECT
SELECT c.name AS customer_name, c.city, c.country
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-11-01'
ORDER BY customer_name
LIMIT 500;

records.question: Which customers live in the city that has the most customers?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT name, city, country, signup_date
FROM customers
WHERE city = (
    SELECT city
    FROM customers
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY city
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY name
LIMIT 500;

records.question: How many orders were placed by customers in Chennai last month?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.city = 'Chennai'
  AND o.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of month', '-1 month')
  AND o.order_date < date('2026-11-07', 'start of month');

records.question: Which products are priced above the average product price?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT name, category, price
FROM products
WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products)
ORDER BY price DESC
LIMIT 500;

records.question: On average, how many orders does a customer place, counting only customers who have ordered? Round to two decimals.
List the cancelled orders from the last 7 days with the customer name and amount.
records.generated_sql:
SELECT o.id AS order_id, c.name AS customer_name, o.total AS amount, o.order_date
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', '-7 days')
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.id DESC
LIMIT 500;
